changelog:
Initial release of the nbnhhsh-skill: a pinyin initialism translator.

- Translates pinyin abbreviations (e.g., xswl) into full Chinese phrases.
- Supports querying multiple abbreviations at once.
- Provides all possible interpretations for each abbreviation.
- Offers a simple API endpoint for integration.
- Notes on API rate limits and possible pending-review results included.
summary: Translate Chinese pinyin initialisms and internet abbreviations to their possible full Chinese meanings, supporting multiple terms at once.
